content:
maya: Hey team — I just merged the KMS client update (libkms v2.4.1) that fixes the CVE we triaged. I'm about to kick off a rolling canary + smoke validation. Can we confirm the checklist and any extra perf guards?

raj: Nice, thanks. Quick checklist: 1) key unwrap/unwrap smoke, 2) latency percentiles pre/post, 3) audit log spikes, 4) RBAC sanity for service accounts.

eli: Adding: run a KV cache warmup before measuring. The patch touches client-side encryption paths so cache cold-start could look worse.

julie: Ops playbook: start 5% traffic to canary pods for 15m, then 20% for 30m if green, then 50% for 20m. Abort on error rate > 0.5% or P95 latency regress > 15%.

maya: Copy. I'll start the rollout. Posting smoke commands below.

maya: ```bash
# smoke: encrypt/decrypt + unwrap/verify
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://kms-internal:8443/v1/keys/dev/encrypt -d '{"plaintext":"test-$i"}' | jq -r .ciphertext > /tmp/c.$i
  curl -sS -X POST https://kms-internal:8443/v1/keys/dev/decrypt -d "{\"ciphertext\": \"$(cat /tmp/c.$i)\"}" | jq -r .plaintext || echo FAIL:$i
done
```

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary=5% -> image=libkms:v2.4.1 -> rollout id r-2026-03-20-01 (automated).

security-bot: Static scans: no new high-severity findings in v2.4.1. New medium: outdated dependency openssl 1.1.1 -> flagged but already patched in our build matrix.

raj: For metrics, use these queries:
- error rate: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"kms\",code!~\"2..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"kms\"}[5m]))
- p95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"kms\"}[5m])) by (le))

julie: Also monitor audit log size: increase could indicate repeated failures/tries. Grafana panel: logs.kms.audit.size /m. Set alert if > 3x baseline in 10m.

eli: Running perf harness now against canary endpoints with burst=200 concurrent to check queuing. Will post numbers in ~10m.

maya: First smoke run: 100/100 encrypt/decrypt OK, no errors in application logs.

eli: Perf snapshot (canary 5%): baseline p95=42ms -> canary p95=46ms (+9.5%). CPU on canary pods +8%. No error spike.

raj: That's within threshold. Keep an eye on RBAC errors — sometimes client upgrades change token headers. Run a quick role-check:
```bash
kubectl exec -n prod svc-kms -- curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN\" https://localhost:8443/v1/keys | jq .
```

maya: RBAC check OK for service accounts used by runtime. No 403s. Audit log entries look normal (one entry per request).

ops-bot: Rollout progressing: 5% -> 20% (completed).

eli: Perf at 20%: p95=48ms (+14% vs baseline). Still under 15% abort threshold but creeping. Disk IO for HSM gateway up ~6%.

julie: Let's pause promotion at 20m hold for additional 30m and run end-to-end smoke from a downstream model server (embedding pipeline) — we saw subtle tail effects before.

maya: Agreed. Scheduling downstream test now.

maya: Downstream smoke: 200 inference calls, success 199/200, one timeout (timeout 5s). Correlating logs.

raj: Timeout trace points to KMS unwrap latency spike at the same timestamp. Might be transient. Open incident if we see >3 timeouts in 10m.

ops-bot: Alert rule: create if unwrap_timeouts_total > 3 in 10m -> pager.

julie: After extra hold, metrics stabilized. No further timeouts. Ops approves continue to 50%.

maya: Rollout to 50% done. Final perf delta at 50% p95=47ms (+12%). Audit log volume +12% (expected telemetry).

raj: Post-rollout followups: 1) schedule a dependency bump for OpenSSL in build image, 2) add a perf regression test to our CI that runs libkms conjured workload on PRs, 3) confirm KMS metrics have new dashboards for unwrap latency per region.

maya: Filing followups. Thanks everyone. :tada: (reacted :thumbsup:)

ops-bot: Rollout completed: 100% target scheduled for next maintenance window (non-disruptive).
